emails.subject: Quick question on AI engineering sourcing
emails.body:
Hi Daniel,

I am building Hirelix for independent technical headhunters who work on software, AI, and data roles.

HeadHunted AI looks tightly focused on AI, ML, MLOps, GenAI, and data engineering search. That is the exact kind of work where a recruiter needs more than keyword matching.

Hirelix turns a client JD into a ranked shortlist of real technical profiles, with evidence for fit, risks to verify, and outreach-ready context.

Would you be open to giving blunt feedback on whether this would save sourcing or review time on one real AI role?

Best,
Noah

Noah Jiang
Founder, Hirelix
https://hirelix.online

If this is not relevant, reply "opt out" and I will not email again.
